name: Close-Grip Bench Press
cues: Grip the bar about shoulder width, no narrower
Pin your shoulder blades back and down
Lower the bar with your elbows tucked near your sides
Touch your lower chest and press back up over your shoulders
Stack your wrists over your elbows

qa.note: v1.x fix 2026-10-08, re-review. Close grip touches lower on the sternum with the forearm stacked under the bar at the touch (side lean 4 deg, was 17); the wrist extends 20 deg (bar low in the palm). The press follows the same J as 101, so the forearm leans toward the head mid-press (max 37, the 101 level); the front-view tilt stays within 18 deg and the upper arm 19+ deg off the ribs. The elbows sit about 12 cm below the pad top at the touch: real geometry for a tucked close grip, but it reads low from the side. The planned low-in-the-palm press grip was dropped: measured, it made the forearms lean more.
